history.topic: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
history.transcribed: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
history.feedback: Phát âm rất xuất sắc và ngữ điệu tự nhiên!

history.topic: What time does the train leave?
history.transcribed: What time does the train leave?
history.feedback: Phát âm khá tốt, cần chú ý nối âm đuôi.

history.topic: Technology is changing the way we communicate every day.
history.transcribed: Technology is changing the way we communicate every day.
history.feedback: Tiến bộ rõ rệt! Ngữ điệu đã mượt mà hơn nhiều.

history.topic: My dog loves playing in the park.
history.transcribed: My dog loves playing in the park.
history.feedback: Cố gắng phát âm rõ phụ âm /k/ trong từ 'park'.

history.topic: Continuous effort, not strength or intelligence, is the key to unlocking our potential.
history.transcribed: Continuous effort, not strength or intelligence, is the key to unlocking our potential.
history.feedback: Tuyệt vời! Ngữ điệu chuẩn học thuật và phát âm hoàn hảo!
